meta.platform: Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP), Kindle eBooks and listing metadata
meta.method: Pages fetched with curl from official hosts, converted to plain text and saved under pages/. Every 'quote' below was machine-checked to be a substring of the saved page named in 'saved_page' (whitespace collapsed).
quote_conventions: Quotes are verbatim from the saved page text with runs of whitespace collapsed to one space.
Table rows are quoted in the saved-text form, with cells joined by ' | '.
Quotes from PDFs come from the PDF text layer, so words broken across lines appear as extracted.
meta.verified_false_means: The item could not be found on an official page. It carries a 'note' and no number was filled in from memory.
meta.derived_true_means: A conclusion drawn here from quoted facts, not a statement made by Amazon.

safe_choice.text: A JPEG in RGB at 2560 x 1600 px (height x width, ratio 1.6:1) under 5 MB meets the strictest reading of all three sources.

minimum_pixels.quote: Minimum dimensions of 1000 pixels in height and 625 pixels in width.

maximum_pixels_each_side.quote: Cover image should not exceed 10,000 pixels in height and in width.

aspect_ratio.quote: An ideal height/width ratio of at least 1.6:1, meaning: For every 1,000 pixels in width, the image should be 1,600 pixels in height.

max_file_size_mb.quote: Your cover image must be less than 50MB.

macos.note: The user guide (v4.0.4) does not document a macOS install path; it only says to pick the disk in the .pkg installer. No official page fetched states /Applications or an app bundle name.

related.quote: Select the disk where you want to install Kindle Previewer and then click Continue.
Double-click the KindlePreviewerInstaller.pkg file to launch the installer.

kdp_help_page.quote: You can download Kindle Previewer for Microsoft Windows 10 (64-bit) and above, Intel Mac and Apple Silicon M1 Mac (macOS 12 and above).

product_page.quote: Windows 10 May 2019 Update - version 1903, build 10.0.18362.0 or later - Intel or Apple Silicon macOS 12 or later

user_guide.quote: Intel Mac (OSX 10.15 and above), or Apple Silicon M1 Mac (macOS 11 and above)

system_requirements.contradiction: The user guide and product-page FAQ say macOS 10.15 (Intel) / macOS 11 (Apple silicon); the KDP help page and the product-page download box say macOS 12 and above.

rosetta.quote: Note: You may be prompted to install Apple’s Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon Macs to support some conversion features.

hardware.quote: processor 1.2 GHz or faster, minimum 4 GB RAM (8GB is recommended), minimum 1.5 GB hard disk drive space, and display resolution of 1024 X 768

supported_input_formats.quote: Kindle Previewer opens eBooks in .epub, .htm, .html, .xhtml, .opf, .kpf, .doc, and .docx formats. Support for .doc and .docx is limited to English language content.

export_formats.quote: Kindle Previewer can export eBooks to the following file formats:

--convert.quote: Create a KPF file in the specified output path or a Mobi file if the book doesn’t support Enhanced Typesetting.

--qualitychecks.quote: Use this option to validate external links, internal links (excluding table of contents), and footnotes in your books. This feature is currently in beta.

--showpreview.quote: Open the converted book in Kindle Previewer's graphical user interface.

--log.quote: Use this option to generate only the log files for validation without generating a KPF or a Mobi file.

--output.quote: Path to the output folder. Use this option to specify a preferred path to store output file(s) instead of the default path (input folder).

two_dash_format_is_new.quote: Updated section 3, Using Kindle Previewer from a Command-Line Interface, with two dash command format

log_location.quote: To review errors or warnings, use the individual log file inside the “output/Logs/” folder.

self_update.quote: You can also run “kindlepreviewer4 --update” from a command-line interface to download and install the latest update.

contradiction.note: The product-page FAQ still tells users to run 'kindlepreviewer --help' and links the old Previewer 3 user guide; the Previewer 4 user guide uses 'kindlepreviewer4'.

evidence.quote: If you have Kindle Previewer installed, run 'kindlepreviewer --help' in a command-line interface to see instructions.
Run “kindlepreviewer4 -- help” from your command line interface to get started.
evidence.note: The PDF wraps the line after the two dashes, which is why the extracted text shows a space; the flag is --help.

errors_block_publishing.quote: Any errors or warnings will prevent the titles from becoming available.

subscription_programme_name.note: KDP help pages and the Terms now call the reading subscription 'Kindle+'. Links on the page still point to /kindleunlimited paths. No fetched page states a rename in so many words.
subscription_programme_name.quote: They can also visit Amazon's Kindle+ page <https://www.amazon.com/kindleunlimited> to see available books in the catalog.
